data.name: Finders
data.detailed_description:
REMEDIUM: SENTINELS - OUT NOW!


SCHOLAR OF THE ARCANE ARTS - OUT NOW IN EARLY ACCESS


Acerca do jogo


Carve a path through an unforgiving wilderness to rescue a hero trapped by a villain! For years, the valiant Altair safeguarded the world from disaster and ensured a peaceful, prosperous existence for mankind. But a madman bent on doing evil figured out a way to confine him. In the wake of Altair's disappearance, disaster struck Earth, with one calamity after another shaking the planet to its core. Now you must lead a band of brave workers on an epic adventure to find the hero, using the cryptic clues on an ancient artifact to guide the way.

To endure the harsh conditions, you will learn to take what you need from the land. Gathering food and water, housing your workers, and mining gold from tunnels will make each new level a breathtaking challenge unlike any you have experienced. As you balance time and resources, you'll also invent clever machines to accomplish special tasks, make friends with a Yeti, and prepare for the impending showdown against your enemy. Developed to provide gamers with a thrilling and accessible adventure, Pathfinders will provide hours of unforgettable fun!

reviews.review:
Finders is the latest of Alawar Entertainment's simulation games to [i]find[/i] its way onto Steam.  Although a bit more casual than I usually enjoy, after getting used to the gameplay I found it to be quite a relaxing and pleasant experience.  

First, let me note that if you're looking for any type of challenge, even if it's an arbitrary goal that you can impose on your own gameplay to perfect your play, this really isn't the game for you.  Finders is a true casual title in that there's no time crunch, no goal that must be met to earn yourself any type of trophy (other than some easy to reach in-game achievements), nothing at all that places stress on the player.   This lack of challenge may prove too bland for some, but those who are looking for true casualness in gameplay may find it just the thing for them.

Gameplay consists of completing various quests by directing your "finders" about an area of the map, completing tasks, solving puzzles and leveling up which unlocks more actions, quests and options for the player.  As you build up your camp, gather resources, complete quests  and cut a path towards your overall objective, a simple story unfolds giving a bit of meaning to everything you're doing.  There is an element of freedom present in that you don't necessarily have to complete any task in order, but to progress you will need to work through those quests. Still, without a ticking clock hounding you, you can take your time planning out moves.  Even the resource management aspect of the game is quite forgiving as you can always spend time gathering foods or other materials if you find yourself short, then get back to questing without issue.

My main complaint is that the tutorial isn't quite as intuitive as it could be.  I spent quite a bit of time in the beginning trying to figure out just what I was supposed to do and what exactly the game itself entailed.  Once you have a grasp of how everything works it gets better, but this may be frustrating for those looking for something easy to jump right into.

For the price, Finders is worth a look if you're in the mood for casual gaming without the rush and stress that most titles in the genre employ.  Perfect for whiling away an hour here and there on lazy afternoons, if only there were Steam Achievement integration of the in-game Awards, but I'll just have to be content with trading cards for now.

Bottom Line: Recommended for players looking for a truly casual experience without the usual time crunch madness of other "casual" sim games.
